description: Source file defining the class S3MultiRegionClient, an extension of the AWS SDK's base S3 multi-region client, implementing functionality for managing region detection, caching, and presigned request generation within the Amazon S3 multi-region context.

classes.name: S3MultiRegionClient
classes.description: A specialized AWS SDK client for Amazon S3 that supports multi-region operations and caching of bucket region information, extending the base multi-region client with additional logic for region determination and presigned URL creation.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Returns the array of arguments/parameters, adding default region handling and a cache configuration for bucket region caching.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the client, cache, and region middleware.

methods.name: determineRegionMiddleware
methods.description: Creates middleware to attach to the handler list, handling region determination and caching logic for commands.

methods.name: createPresignedRequest
methods.description: Creates a presigned URL request for an S3 object, ensuring that the bucket is specified and that the regional client is used.

methods.name: getObjectUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL for accessing an S3 object, based on the bucket's region.

methods.name: determineBucketRegionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously determines the region of a specified bucket, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: getCacheKey
methods.description: Constructs cache key for storing/retrieving bucket region information.
